integrity: The all-parameter result is proved by a forest-independence and triangle-count argument; exhaustive small cases corroborate but are not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Uniform independent letters, three distinct burst lengths, deletion-only diversity. Marginal enumeration and single-lag binomial law are prior-known, not new. The exact cross-lag mixed third cumulant and arithmetic resonance are the contribution. Generic cycle-moment reductions in other literatures and unindexed equivalents remain potential originality risks; independent audit not performed.
title: Additive-lag third-cumulant law for burst-deletion diversity
